title: Contiguous
summary: CONTIGUOUS, adjective [Latin , con and tango, tago, to touch.] Touching; meeting or joining at the surface or border; as two contiguous bodies or countries. The houses in ancient Rome were not contigu

inlines.v: CONTIGUOUS, adjective [Latin , con and tango, tago, to touch.] Touching; meeting or joining at the surface or border; as two contiguous bodies or countries. The houses in ancient Rome were not contiguous Usually followed by to. Bacon uses with, but he has not been followed.
